```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(gt)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidymodels)

here::i_am("satp-counts.qmd")

# Load custom functions
source(here("data-viz/table_functions.R"))
source(here("data-viz/heatmap_functions.R"))

# ── Pre-computed bootstrap p-values (run bootstrap_*.R scripts once) ──────────
boot_baseline_seq2seq <- read_csv(
  here("results/bootstrap_baseline_seq2seq.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
boot_baseline_llms    <- read_csv(
  here("results/bootstrap_baseline_llms.csv"),    show_col_types = FALSE)
boot_rarebin_seq2seq  <- read_csv(
  here("results/bootstrap_rare_bin_seq2seq.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
boot_rarebin_llms     <- read_csv(
  here("results/bootstrap_rare_bin_llms.csv"),    show_col_types = FALSE)

# ── Point estimates ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
metrics_seq2seq <- load_seq2seq_baseline_metrics(here("results/death-counts-seq2seq"))
metrics_llms    <- load_llm_baseline_metrics(here("results/death-counts-llms"))

metrics_rarebin_seq2seq <- load_seq2seq_rare_bin_metrics(
  results_dir = here("results/death-counts-seq2seq"),
  rarebin_dir = here("results/rare-bins/seq2seq")
)
metrics_rarebin_llms <- load_llm_rare_bin_metrics(
  llm_dir     = here("results/death-counts-llms"),
  rarebin_dir = here("results/rare-bins/llms")
)

# ── Bin-level data for heatmaps ───────────────────────────────────────────────
bin_seq2seq <- load_seq2seq_bin_metrics(here("results/death-counts-seq2seq"))
bin_llms    <- load_llm_bin_metrics(here("results/death-counts-llms"))
```

# Results

## Baseline Model Comparisons

[Results text to be written. Tables @tbl-seq2seq-baseline and @tbl-llm-baseline report overall performance for the seq2seq and LLM model families respectively. Values in bold are significantly better than the ConfliBERT-Poisson baseline (paired bootstrap, $n = 5{,}000$ replications, $p < .05$); a dagger (†) indicates the model is not significantly different from the ceiling model.]

```{r}
#| label: tbl-seq2seq-baseline
#| tbl-cap: "Death count extraction performance: seq2seq models."

make_baseline_gt(
  metrics_df  = metrics_seq2seq,
  pvals_df    = boot_baseline_seq2seq,
  model_order = c("conflibert", "t5_base", "t5_large",
                  "indicbart", "mt5", "nt5", "t5_xl"),
  col_labels  = c(
    conflibert = "ConfliBERT",
    t5_base    = "T5-Base",
    t5_large   = "T5-Large",
    indicbart  = "IndicBART",
    mt5        = "mT5-Base",
    nt5        = "NT5-Small",
    t5_xl      = "T5-XL"
  ),
  n_boot = 5000
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-llm-baseline
#| tbl-cap: "Death count extraction performance: large language models."

make_baseline_gt(
  metrics_df  = metrics_llms,
  pvals_df    = boot_baseline_llms,
  model_order = c("conflibert", "llama3_8b", "mistral_7b",
                  "mixtral_8x7b", "gpt4o_mini"),
  col_labels  = c(
    conflibert   = "ConfliBERT",
    llama3_8b    = "Llama-3.1-8B",
    mistral_7b   = "Mistral-7B",
    mixtral_8x7b = "Mixtral-8x7B",
    gpt4o_mini   = "GPT-4o-mini"
  ),
  n_boot = 5000
)
```

## Bin-Level Performance

[Figures @fig-heatmap-seq2seq and @fig-heatmap-llms decompose performance by death count bin, revealing the systematic failure of all models on high-fatality events.]

```{r}
#| label: fig-heatmap-combined
#| fig-cap: "Exact match (%) by death count bin. Seq2seq models (top) and LLMs (bottom), each ordered by overall MAE (best at top). ConfliBERT-Poisson appears in both panels as a reference baseline."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 8

make_combined_heatmap(
  seq2seq_df = bin_seq2seq,
  llm_df     = bin_llms
)
```

## Rare-Bin Improvement Strategies

### Seq2Seq Training-Side Interventions

[Table @tbl-rarebin-seq2seq reports results for five training-side interventions applied to Flan-T5-Large. Strategies are labeled R1--R5 following the notation introduced in Section XX.]

```{r}
#| label: tbl-rarebin-seq2seq
#| tbl-cap: "Seq2seq rare-bin intervention results (Flan-T5-Large base)."

make_rare_bin_gt(
  metrics_df     = metrics_rarebin_seq2seq,
  pvals_df       = boot_rarebin_seq2seq,
  strategy_order = c("S0", "S1", "S2", "S3", "S4", "S5", "T5-XL"),
  col_labels     = c(
    S0         = "Baseline",
    S1         = "Weighted",
    S2         = "Loss Wt.",
    S3         = "Targeted",
    S4         = "Back-transl.",
    S5         = "Paraphrase",
    "T5-XL"    = "T5-XL"
  ),
  n_boot = 5000
)
```

### LLM Prompt Engineering Interventions

[Table @tbl-rarebin-llms reports results for four prompt engineering strategies applied to Llama-3.1-8B.]

```{r}
#| label: tbl-rarebin-llms
#| tbl-cap: "LLM prompt engineering results (Llama-3.1-8B base)."

make_rare_bin_gt(
  metrics_df     = metrics_rarebin_llms,
  pvals_df       = boot_rarebin_llms,
  strategy_order = c("L0", "L1", "L2", "L3", "L4", "GPT-L0"),
  col_labels     = c(
    L0         = "Baseline",
    L1         = "Protocol",
    L2         = "Bin-shot",
    L3         = "Hard-shot",
    L4         = "Combined",
    "GPT-L0"   = "GPT-4o-mini"
  ),
  n_boot = 5000
)
```
